import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

headers = { 'Authorization': "Bearer REPLACE_BEARER_TOKEN" }

conn.request("PATCH", "/rest/v1.1/projects/%7Bproject_id%7D/recycle_bin/checklist/lists/%7Bid%7D/restore", headers=headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
